Including a clause about payment timing and method could clarify arrangements and show good faith readiness, prompting more substantive responses from opposing counsel. I will also add headings for clarity and a reciprocity clause to preserve the relationship balance, supporting the quick deal closure both firms desire.

Best regards,

Aldous Finch LLP
